Hi Rafael,

Thanks for sending the latest MSA. Our legal team made a few edits on the insurance section and attached a redlined copy (redlined_MSA_ACME_v3.pdf). The key asks from our side are:

- Increase minimum general liability to $2M per occurrence / $4M aggregate (we currently show $1M)
- Additional insured: we need Redwood to name Acme as additional insured on a primary, non-contributory basis for claims related to services under the order form
- Waiver of subrogation in favor of Acme on the policies
- COI: request that your broker provide a certificate of insurance showing the required limits and confirm additional insured status; endorsement naming language should be delivered within 10 business days of signing

We can be flexible on the general liability number if you instead confirm cyber liability limits and a vendor security attestation — happy to discuss. Please confirm whether Redwood's broker will send the COI and endorsement directly to contracts@acme.com or if you prefer to route through your legal mailbox.

Attached: redlined_MSA_ACME_v3.pdf

Regards,
Maya Johnson
Sr. Contracts Manager

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: MSA insurance redlines and COI deliverable

Team — I reviewed Acme's redlines. High level: the changes are mostly reasonable but we should push on two items to limit long-term exposure.

- Limits: moving to $2M/$4M GL is acceptable for this deal size; we should not concede further increases. For cyber, request at least $1M if Acme wants lower GL.
- Additional insured: we can accept being named as additional insured for claims directly tied to Redwood's services, provided the endorsement is "primary and non-contributory" and the policy does not reduce our coverage rights via broad contractual liability. Proposed endorsement wording we can offer: 
  "The insurer shall endorse the policy to name Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents as Additional Insured with respect to liability arising out of the operations performed by or on behalf of the Named Insured under the Agreement."
- Waiver of subrogation: we will accept a waiver of subrogation tied to the same scope as the additional insured clause.

Operational asks: require COI showing coverage and the endorsement reference within 7 business days of signature; full endorsement (endorsement form) within 30 calendar days. If Acme insists on 10 business days for full endorsement, we can accept but prefer the 30-day window.

I’ve attached a COI template (COI_template_Redwood.pdf) and a short redlined snippet of the MSA insurance section. Lauren — please hold execution until broker confirms timing.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: COI_template_Redwood.pdf
